__comment: No fluorite ore in a void world - this keystone bridge is the skyblock source of Mekanism fluorite, which the fission fuel line (Hydrofluoric Acid -> Uranium Hexafluoride -> Fissile Fuel) requires. Without it, antimatter and the Heart of the Sky are uncraftable. SHAPED, not shapeless: all four keystone bridges (certus/fluorite/osmium/uraninite) used the identical shapeless set of 1 keystone + 2 sky dust, so Minecraft only ever matched the first one and the other three were uncraftable. Same cost, distinct arrangement.
